title: Sergeant’s Mom Gets Kicked Off Flight, But Still Thinks She's In Charge
description:
On February 15th, 2024. Flight crew called police regarding a drunk woman who was causing a major disturbance on the airline to the point where her and her husband had to be removed. When police were interacting with her, the woman continued to be rude and completely belligerent.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
